description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations used for wireless network interface management, including initialization, configuration, and setup of wireless devices, interfaces, access points, mesh networks, and related configurations within a network management context.

methods.name: wdev_tool
methods.description: Wrapper for ucode invocation for device operations related to wireless devices.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Function to call ubus commands with locking.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_device_config
methods.description: Initializes device-specific configuration parameters.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_iface_config
methods.description: Initializes interface-specific configuration parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds capability flags based on given capabilities.

methods.name: mac80211_add_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds High Efficiency (HE) capabilities.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Sets up basic hostapd configuration for a wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Configures and sets up a BSS (Basic Service Set) in hostapd.

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a given wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a wireless interface.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Gets the physical interface name from board configuration JSON.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames phy based on configuration file path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames phy based on board configuration JSON.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Attempts to find and rename physical wireless interfaces based on various identifiers.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks if a wireless interface is an AP (Access Point).

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets interface name and index based on prefix and type.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface with configuration and possible security settings.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_iw_htmode
methods.description: Prepares the HT mode for the interface based on configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_add_mesh_params
methods.description: Adds mesh-specific parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_adhoc
methods.description: Configures an adhoc wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_mesh
methods.description: Configures a mesh wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_monitor
methods.description: Sets up a monitor mode wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_vif_txpower
methods.description: Sets the transmit power for a wireless interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_interface
methods.description: Adds a wireless interface to wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: hostapd_set_config
methods.description: Configures hostapd with current interface settings.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_start
methods.description: Starts the wpa_supplicant process for a given device.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_supplicant
methods.description: Configures wpa_supplicant for wireless interfaces.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Sets up a wireless virtual interface.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Gets the frequency of a given channel on a physical device.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel requires DFS radar detection.

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Sets a flag to disable scanning.

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets the configuration of the wireless device.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffixes for phy and vif based on radio index.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main driver setup function for mac80211, initializes hardware, configures interfaces, and manages wireless devices.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the device configuration during teardown.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Detects whether the device supports AP mode.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Assigns interface names based on mode and prefix.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares and configures a virtual wireless interface based on JSON configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Initializes and sets up individual VIFs, including support for security setup, mesh, adhoc, and monitor modes.
